summary.en-US: PantsOnly removes YouTube Shorts from navigation, feeds, search, recommendations, and direct links.

version.approval_notes: The extension makes no network requests and collects no data. rules.js is the selector source of truth; hide-shorts.css is generated by npm run generate. Reproduce the submitted Firefox package with npm ci && npm run package using Node.js 22.13 or newer. The result is dist/firefox/pantsonly-firefox.zip.
